questions.question: Seven people D, E, F, G, H, I and J are sitting in a straight row, facing north. Only three people sit between D and H. E sits fourth to the left of J. Only D is between E and I. J sits third to the right of F. Who sits at the second position from the right end of the row?

Given: Seven people D, E, F, G, H, I and J are sitting in a straight row, facing north.

3) J sits third to the right of F. So, case 1 will be eliminated.

Clearly, H is sitting second to the right end of the row.

Hence, the correct answer is "H".

questions.question:
Three statements are given followed by three conclusions numbered 1, 2 and 3. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some shoes are slippers.

Some slippers are socks.

All socks are sandals.

**Conclusions:**

1. Some sandals are shoes.

2. Some sandals are slippers.

3. Some socks are shoes.
questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is given below according to the given information.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1af7ae9c01c217e028350cb81e91ab5b143d9cb250bf5166e940308e719e903f.png] 

Conclusion: 

1. Some sandals are shoes → Does not follow → As, some shoes are slippers, some slippers are socks, and all socks are sandals. So, some sandals are shoes is possible but not definitely followed.

2. Some sandals are slippers →** Follow → **As, some slippers are socks and all socks are sandals. So some sandals are slippers is definitely followed.

3. Some socks are shoes → **Does not follow **→ As, some shoes are slippers, some slippers are socks, and all socks are sandals. So, some socks are shoes is possible but not definitely followed.

Only conclusion II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number and the fourth number is related to the third number.

18 ∶ 4 ∶∶ 36 ∶ 16 ∶∶ 27 ∶ ?
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

**Logic:- { sqrt{Second number}}** × 9 = First number.

1) 18 : 4

⇒ {sqrt{4}} × 9

⇒ 2 × 9 = 18

And,

2) 36 : 16

⇒ { sqrt{16} } × 9

⇒ 4 × 9 = 36

Similarly,

3) 27 : ?

⇒ { sqrt{x} } × 9 = 27

⇒ { sqrt{x}} = 27 ÷ 9

⇒ {sqrt{x} } = 3

⇒ 9 

Hence, the correct answer is **"9"**

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third word in the same way as the second word is related to the first word. (The words must be considered as meaningful English words and must not be related to each other based on the number of letters/number of consonants/vowels in the word.)

Virology : Viruses :: Cardiology : ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: The second word is the subject or focus of the study field represented by the first word.

Here, Virology : Viruses → Viruses are the subject of study in Virology.

Similarly, Cardiology : ? → Heart is the subject of study in Cardiology.

**Hence, the correct answer is "Heart".**

questions.question: A is married to Z. Z has 3 children L, M and N. Z is not the father of the children. P is the mother of A. L is the husband of D. M has 2 daughters H and J. How is Z related to P?
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94f0af2bd93b93688d2c6092e652fb2d84f74342de195154154b4e73abc5a0da.png] 

1) A is married to Z. 

2) Z has 3 children L, M and N. Z is not the father of the children

(It means Z is the mother of L, M and Z)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bf1b48762f44fd2d6fb9421511efafa1f1a3365a261a3cfe1241237847d9b566.png] 

3) P is the mother of A.

4) L is the husband of D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/458257190d779c10fb3e9184658144b105889c3e7fe1325e8660fbc0c05be21b.png] 

Clearly, Z is the daughter-in-law of P.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Daughter in law".**
